recon.variance_source: Means in the columns, concerning the selected traits, followed by different small letters are significantly different at p < 0.05
recon.control_definition: Control (C) - pure water application with no biostimulant
recon.treatment_definition: Four biostimulant treatments: SS 0.7% (single spraying 0.7%), SS 1.0% (single spraying 1.0%), DS 0.7% (double spraying 0.7%), DS 1.0% (double spraying 1.0%)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Multiple treatment levels could be confused - need to extract each treatment vs control separately
recon.sample_size_source: The experiments were established in a randomized block design in four replicates on experimental plots of 10m²
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract seed yield data from Table 5 for each cultivar separately. Compare each of the 4 biostimulant treatments (SS 0.7%, SS 1.0%, DS 0.7%, DS 1.0%) against the control (C) for each cultivar. Use 'Average application (AA)' column data which represents the 3-year average. Calculate variance from LSD values if provided, or note significance letters for effect size determination.

table_descriptions.Table 4: Biometric characteristics (plant height, nodes, pod location, pod number)
table_descriptions.Table 5: Seed yield data including number of seeds per m², seed yield (t ha⁻¹), and 1000 seed weight
